translations.title: Translate {{field}}
translations.description: The form holds the {{locale}} version. Anything left blank here falls back to it, so a partly translated record still renders.
translations.none: This service publishes a single language, so there is nothing to translate.
translations.source_empty: Nothing written in the form yet, so there is nothing to translate.
translations.translatable_hint: Turn it off for text that is the same in every language, like an application's name. It clears what is written here.
translations.generate_failed: No draft came back. Try again, or write the translation yourself.
translations.generate_hint: A draft, never a publication: read it before you save.
translations.too_long: Too long to draft automatically — {{max}} characters at most. Translate it in pieces, or write it yourself.
